title: Mujikaku Seijo wa Kyou mo Muishiki ni Chikara wo Tare Nagasu

thread.title: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power • Mujikaku Seijo wa Kyou mo Muishiki ni Chikara wo Tare Nagasu - Episode 12 discussion - FINAL

opinions.point: Several commenters felt the writing was rushed, with conflicts and character arcs receiving too little development.
The antagonists and their motivations were often considered implausible or poorly constructed.
Some viewers enjoyed the emotional and romantic payoff, while others found the resolution abrupt and insufficiently earned.
A minority strongly praised the cast, character development, and overall ending.
The series was viewed by some as an enjoyable genre entry with good moments, but weaker than comparable saint-themed fantasy romances.

notes: The thread title explicitly names Mujikaku Seijo wa Kyou mo Muishiki ni Chikara wo Tare Nagasu and episode 12, with no season marker conflict. I read 29 substantive comments. Reddit’s rendered page did not expose reliable thread score or total comment count, so those fields are reported as 0.
